content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I connected two 5K potentiometers to my [product_name] base unit (using a 6.8k series resistor) to simulate analog signals. Initially, both channels gave readings from 0 to about 940 through the full rotation while monitoring online. Now, AI3 has stopped working. I measured the voltage at the channel input and it's now 10.4V, so I'm wondering if the channel might have been overloaded. Has anyone else encountered this problem?
The analog inputs should handle up to 28.8 VDC without issue.

Hello, by default the [product_name] with onboard analog supports only 2 analog inputs. To use more, you need to adjust the configuration from 2 to 4 analog inputs. In [product_name] Soft Comfort, go to: File, Properties, I/O Setting, and change from 2 AI to 4 AI. I hope this information helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report confusion when one analog channel (AI3) on a [product_name] base module stops working after successful initial use. There is uncertainty about electrical limits and whether a manual configuration is required to enable additional analog inputs, as this information is not obvious from the interface or documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all analog input channels on the [product_name] base module to function reliably after setup and for the system to either automatically detect, or clearly indicate, any configuration changes needed, without risking hardware damage.
